title: Can 4104 be written as a sum of two cubes in two ways?
description: Four thousand one hundred four is written as a sum of two cubes in two ways, by taking one cube away and checking whether the rest is a cube. Keeko doubts the leftover eight, because it looks too small to be a cube.
teaching_notes: One idea: take a cube away from the number and test whether the rest is also a cube. Watch for students who think a small leftover number cannot be a cube.

source: Show that 4104 is a sum of two cubes in two different ways.
video_script.why: The child writes a taxicab number as a sum of two cubes in two ways by taking away a large cube and testing the rest.
video_script.substitution: Cube a number just below the root of the target, take it away, and check whether the leftover is a cube.
video_script.anchor: a taxi number plate showing four thousand one hundred four
video_script.wrong_answer: eight is too small to be a cube
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko sees the leftover eight after taking away sixteen cubed and thinks it is too small to be a cube. Eight is two cubed, so a small number can be a cube.
video_script.payoff_line: Four thousand one hundred four is two cubed plus sixteen cubed, and nine cubed plus fifteen cubed

final_answer.spoken: four thousand one hundred four is two cubed plus sixteen cubed, and nine cubed plus fifteen cubed

narration: <bookmark mark='book'/>This question is from your book.
<bookmark mark='taxi'/>Ziva rode in a taxi numbered one thousand seven hundred twenty nine, and thought it dull.
<bookmark mark='reply'/>Leeza replied that it is very interesting. It is the sum of two cubes in two different ways.
<bookmark mark='term'/>A number like this is called a taxicab number.
<bookmark mark='next'/>The next taxicab number is four thousand one hundred four.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>How can we show it is a sum of two cubes in two different ways?

narration: <bookmark mark='first'/>One thousand seven hundred twenty nine is one cubed plus twelve cubed.
<bookmark mark='second'/>It is also nine cubed plus ten cubed.
<bookmark mark='find'/>To find such a pair, we take one large cube away and test the rest.
<bookmark mark='given'/>Given, the number four thousand one hundred four.

beats.on_screen: To find: two ways to write 4104 as a sum of two cubes

marks.find: the thing to find is written

narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to write it as a sum of two cubes in two different ways.
<bookmark mark='sixteen'/>Step one, try sixteen cubed, which is four thousand ninety six.
<bookmark mark='left'/>Four thousand one hundred four minus four thousand ninety six leaves eight.
<bookmark mark='cube'/>Eight is two cubed, so we have two cubed plus sixteen cubed.
<bookmark mark='fifteen'/>Step two, try fifteen cubed, which is three thousand three hundred seventy five.
<bookmark mark='left'/>Four thousand one hundred four minus three thousand three hundred seventy five leaves seven hundred twenty nine.
<bookmark mark='cube'/>That is nine cubed, so we have nine cubed plus fifteen cubed.
<bookmark mark='first'/>Step three, check by adding.
Eight plus four thousand ninety six is four thousand one hundred four.
<bookmark mark='second'/>Seven hundred twenty nine plus three thousand three hundred seventy five is also four thousand one hundred four.
<bookmark mark='ans'/>Four thousand one hundred four is two cubed plus sixteen cubed, and nine cubed plus fifteen cubed.
<bookmark mark='hand'/>Keeko has raised a hand. Let us check the doubt and solve it.

beats.on_screen: Keeko's bubble says the leftover 8 is too small to be a cube; 2 × 2 × 2 = 8 appears as a small cube of edge 2 and the bubble is struck through

marks.build: 2 × 2 × 2 = 8 is written and a small cube of edge 2 is built
marks.fix: the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks eight is too small to be a cube, so sixteen cubed seems to leave nothing useful.
<bookmark mark='build'/>But two times two times two is eight.
<bookmark mark='fix'/>A cube can be small. Eight is the cube of two.
